name: drawpoint
description: Pointer-based access to drawpoints — position, drawbell, the IMZ slice geometry above them, and the requested versus actual extracted mass per day and per period.
notes: `massflow.drawpoint.radius(dp, i)` and `height(dp, i)` index the IMZ slices listed by `massflow.drawpoint.slices(dp)`.
`mass.requested` works by day; `mass.actual`, `mass.actual.cum` and `mass.actual.period` report what was really drawn.
`mass.requested` is the scheduled daily tonnage — the period mass divided by the period length. On the tutorial model (2000 per 7-day period) it reads 285.714 for every day of the period.

`mass.actual` is quantised to whole markers, so a day either extracts a marker's worth or nothing: days 1-3 of DP1 read 325, 0, 0 while `mass.actual.cum` holds at 325. Over period 1 the requested 2000 came out as 1625 = 5 x 325.
`massflow.mass.DpDay(1,1)` returned 0 on that same model while `massflow.drawpoint.mass.actual(dp,1)` returned 325 — the two do not agree, so prefer the drawpoint accessors for per-day mass.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.active
intrinsics.description: Return the active state of the drawpoint. Returns true if mass is being extracted during the current period. Returns false otherwise.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.drawbell.id
intrinsics.description: Get the ID of the drawbell associated with the drawpoint dp.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.drawbell.name
intrinsics.description: Get the name of the drawbell associated with the drawpoint dp.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.extra
intrinsics.description: massflow.drawpoint.extra(dp,int>) := a Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the drawpoint. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.find
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the drawpoint with internally assigned ID number i. If no drawpoint exists with that ID number, then null is returned.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.group
intrinsics.description: massflow.drawpoint.group(dp,slot>) := s Get/set the group name assigned to drawpoint dp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.height
intrinsics.description: Get the height, for this drawpoint, at slice number i.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.id
intrinsics.description: Get the ID of a drawpoint.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.list
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the container of all drawpoints in the block model.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.mass.actual
intrinsics.description: Get the actual mass pulled for this drawpoint at DAY i.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.mass.actual.cum
intrinsics.description: Get the actual cumulative mass pulled for this drawpoint at DAY i.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.mass.requested
intrinsics.description: Get the requested mass for this drawpoint at DAY i. This comes from the input draw schedule.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.name
intrinsics.description: Get the name assigned to drawpoint dp.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.near.list
intrinsics.description: Return a fish::List of drawpoint pointers (DP_PNT) that lie strictly within a given 3D radius from the provided drawpoint.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.num
intrinsics.description: Get the total number of drawpoints in the model.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.pos
intrinsics.description: v = massflow.drawpoint.pos(dp) Get the drawpoint centroid position.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.radius
intrinsics.description: Get the radius of a given IMZ slice of a drawpoint.

intrinsics.name: massflow.drawpoint.slices
intrinsics.description: Get a pointer to the container of all drawpoint IMZ slice radii for a given drawpoint.
